summary.result: Overall, the result showed that constructed wetland system is a feasible alternative for the treatment of wastewater from industrial complex in rural areas.
summary.background: Natural wastewater treatment systems using the constructed wetland system were evaluated for the wastewater from the industrial complex in rural areas.
summary.method: For the SS, the effluent concentration was consistently lower than the water quality standard even though the influent concentration varied significantly, which showed that SS was removed by the system effectively which consist of soil and plants.
